title: Remove the compile-time-constant channel description
description: Same reasoning as CHANNEL_NAME: a `const val` can't call context.getString(), and this is only used inside createNotificationChannel(context: Context) which already has a Context. Uses change_type=modify with an empty exact_code for the same determinism reason as the previous task.
acceptance_criteria: The 'private const val CHANNEL_DESC = ...' line is removed
start_anchor: private const val CHANNEL_DESC = "Daily quest reminders, streak alerts, and milestone celebrations"
